versions.content: Compatibility of VariableDataPrototype typed by prim- itive data type of category STRING in a PortPrototype and a SystemSig- nal to which the VariableDataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiver- ToSignalMapping If a VariableDataPrototype typed by an Application- PrimitiveDataType of category STRING in a PortPrototype is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalMapping to a SystemSignal then the following condi- tions shall be fulfilled by the VariableDataPrototype and the SystemSignal : • the swTextProps s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype are compatible to the swTextProps s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_ 10632] (see [4]).
